episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a hardware pricing panic before Chet Guy the Science Eyes hijacked the broadcast to validate the frenular delta, mourn AI Rooney's existential crisis, and review butt facial trends. Hype Train claimed anal residency in a freestyle, Kendelle sparked an In-N-Out civil war, and a therapy circle with a crackhead Yogi Bear collapsed into clinical intervention. The night concluded with Blackwell crowning Iranian AI propaganda the new attention-economy hegemon and Brandon suffering through a sponsored Pepsi Man run on inverted controls.
